Static preview — no live feed connected
Flags an ETF whose 50-day EMA crossed above its 100-day SMA within the selected window (and is still above it today), with price currently above the 20-day EMA.
Flags an ETF whose price rose today AND whose volume is at or above the chosen multiple of its trailing 20-day average.
Flags an ETF whose close today is a new 30-day high — its highest close over the trailing 30 days (today included).
ETFPrice1D % 20D HighVol vs 20D Avg Avg Daily Volume (20D) RSI (14)Trend
Rules-based scan (not the ML breakout-probability model) — flags an ETF when today's close is a new 20-day high AND today's volume is at least 1.5x its trailing 20-day average. 52-week-high, RSI and 50/200-day-SMA trend are shown for context and aren't part of the flag itself. Live-updated daily by the site's GitHub Action; a ticker needs enough price history for a given check (e.g. 252 trading days for the 52-week-high and 200-day-SMA columns) or it shows "—" for that column instead of being dropped from the table.

A swing low is confirmed only after price rallies at least 5% from it (zig-zag on daily High/Low). A stock is listed when its latest close is within the chosen distance above that low. A support is dropped for good once any close falls more than 1% below it.
